part.text:
Fixed in lib/core/AxiosHeaders.js, mirroring the upstream v1.1.3 fix for #5085:

- `normalizeValue()` now preserves arrays (`value.map(normalizeValue)`) instead of coercing them to a comma-joined string — this was the root cause, since `normalize()` (called on response headers via transformData) stringified the `set-cookie` array.
- `toJSON(asStrings)` now keeps array values by default and only joins them when `asStrings=true`.

Validation:
- `test/unit/core/AxiosHeaders.js`: 25 passing (includes the "should support array values" normalize/toJSON test).
- Full mocha unit suite: 100 passing, 2 failing — both confirmed pre-existing on the unmodified baseline (network-dependent http adapter tests).
- End-to-end repro from the issue: `res.headers.get('set-cookie')` now returns the cookie array.
